package_layout: data/evaluation/semantic_gold/<discipline-slug>/<version>/{MANIFEST.json, subset.json, blind_export.csv, form_cases.json, labels/, agreement.json, adjudication.json, semantic_gold_v1.json, metrics.json, assistant_adjudication.json}

reviewers.role: independent domain reviewer (faculty or practitioner of the discipline)
reviewers.independence: each reviewer labels all 48 alone; names that denote the assistant or a model are refused

agreement.two_reviewers: Cohen's kappa + raw agreement + per-class specific agreement + disagreement matrix

adjudication: a named human adjudicator chooses one of the reviewers' labels or AMBIGUOUS; the model answer and the assistant adjudication are never shown or used
gold: semantic_gold_v1: UNANIMOUS or ADJUDICATED cases only; UNRESOLVED/UNLABELLED listed and excluded; immutable once frozen

gate.declared_before: any independent human label for the 48-case human-validation subset existed (0 label files in data/evaluation/semantic_gold/*/v1/labels at declaration)
gate.supersedes: semantic-gate-v2 (sha256 d16871cffa28bbb867549f153359dfb808a9b67c57445ca6c8f86d80c9825f82), unchanged except the gold size: human validation uses the stratified 48-case subset of the frozen 88, so min_gold_cases 80 could never be met

safe_mode: Qwen stays SAFE_MODE until metrics.json reports INDEPENDENTLY_EVALUATED and the v3 gate passes; then only classes meeting the per-class bar are promoted
new_discipline: python3 scripts/evaluation/semantic_validation.py build --discipline "<name>" --benchmark <frozen benchmark of that discipline> (no code change)
